## Key Findings

**Overall Performance:** Degraded across all metrics
- Accuracy: -3.03% (0.6801 → 0.6498)
- Brier score: +0.0023 (worsened)
- AUC: -2.56% (0.7327 → 0.7071)

**High-Confidence Predictions:** Improved significantly
- Top 25% accuracy: +5.48% (0.7919 → 0.8467)
- Top 10% accuracy: +3.34% (0.8333 → 0.8667)

**Underdog Performance:** Severe degradation (HIGH PRIORITY per goals)
- Overall accuracy: -3.52% (0.6831 → 0.6479)
- Overall ROI: -23 percentage points (0.33 → 0.10)
- +250_plus odds band: Accuracy dropped from 47.1% to 22.2%, ROI from 0.92 to -0.16
- All underdog odds bands degraded

**Favorites Performance:** Degraded
- Accuracy: -2.58% (0.6774 → 0.6516)

**Underdog Confidence Breakdown:** Mixed results
- Top 10% confidence: Improved (+2.8% accuracy, +0.16 ROI)
- Top 25% confidence: Degraded (-8.1% accuracy, -0.13 ROI)
- Bottom 75% confidence: Degraded (-4.1% accuracy, -0.30 ROI)

The model became more extreme: higher accuracy on its most confident predictions but significantly worse on the broader prediction set, with particularly severe degradation in underdog performance across all odds bands.
